name: Ferienwohnungen Konrad
beschreibung:
Centrally and sunnily located in picturesque Soell, Ferienwohnungen Konrad provides ideal accommodations for a carefree holiday. The modern apartments feature fully equipped kitchens, spacious living rooms, and mountain-view balconies.

The Soell cable car connecting to SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser - Brixental and summer highlights like Hexenwasser are quickly accessible.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienwohnungen Konrad in Soell offers comfortable holiday apartments for families at the foot of the Wilder Kaiser.
